reason: The cited lines show validation of click parameters, an internal socket message to perform a browser click, and returning the current page URL/title/ARIA snapshot. They do not show arbitrary host code execution. They also do not show agent-supplied data being sent to an attacker-readable destination; the only send is to a fixed internal socket message. The returned browser page snapshot/title/URL can contain attacker-controlled web page content, so UNTRUSTED is supported. The lines could return private page content depending on the browser state, but they do not by themselves establish access to non-public data, so SECRET is insufficient.
